inspection_notes: One generation. Source PNG copied intact, no pixel editing or rescaling.

Visual side-by-side comparison preserves the upper-left amber root tree, upper-right honeycomb rock, lower corner giant leaves and left/right opening contours. No obvious large perimeter geometry displacement was found.
Paving is visibly smaller and denser; large repeated honeycomb emblems were removed and cream floor brightness increased.

The generator did not precisely meet the requested 45–85px widths everywhere: some central pavers visually remain approximately 100–150 source pixels wide. This is a declared limitation, not a verified exact stone-size guarantee.
Runtime code and the v2 collision metadata were not modified.
preserve: 1536×1024 framing, complete perimeter silhouette and positions, left/right exits; v2 metadata untouched
change: central paving only; ordinary stone width 45–85 source px, occasional max 100px; milky honey-ivory low-noise material
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revision v3 of the existing Amber Hive complete 2.5D environment background.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET, 1536 x 1024. Preserve exactly the same 1536 x 1024 canvas size, 3:2 ratio, high-angle three-quarter near-isometric camera, lighting, and room/world scale. DO NOT shrink or zoom the whole scene to make the stones smaller.
Edit ONLY the central walkable STONE PAVING and the visible paving continuing into the existing left/right openings. The goal is much SMALLER paving stones and a quieter milky cream palette.
Stone scale: replace the current oversized 200–300 pixel bouldery slabs with human-scale irregular limestone PAVERS, ordinary individual paver widths around 45–85 SOURCE IMAGE PIXELS, occasional 100 pixels maximum. Increase linear paving density by about 2.5x. The scene should contain MANY small pavers across the clear ground, not a few huge slabs. Do not merely add cracks inside giant slabs; actually draw smaller complete stones with soft shallow seams. Keep shapes hand-authored and gently varied, not perfectly repeating rectangles or tiles. No massive fissures, broken-rock holes or deep cracks.
Floor materials/colors: predominantly light honey-MILK IVORY and pale cream limestone, low-saturation soft beige seams. Only a few subtle pale beeswax-gold fragments, tiny tender-green moss flecks at seams and extremely faint lavender bounced shading. The center should be fresh and light, much less yellow than the existing floor. Remove the repeated large honeycomb emblems completely; if any insect engraving remains it must be very small, sparse and faint. Avoid dense noisy mottling.
CRITICAL IMMUTABLE PERIMETER: Do not move, resize, replace or redesign ANY perimeter geometry. Keep the identical upper-left amber tree trunk and roots, upper-right cream honeycomb rock mound, top distant hive valley silhouette, all four side leaf and flower clusters, lower-left giant-leaf cluster, lower-right amber rock border, their exact silhouettes and positions. Preserve the same left-middle and right-middle open exits and the same stone-versus-perimeter boundary contour. The existing collision outlines depend on these positions. Keep existing warm sunlight and shadows from those perimeter objects in place. Perimeter plants, amber, flowers and chitin rocks must remain as close to the original pixels as possible. The original lower-corner leaf/root boundaries are NOT to be re-authored.
The wide central floor remains flat, dry, empty, continuous and walkable. No added HUD, text, actors, monsters, loot, furniture, beacons, nests, flags, walls, stairs, pillars, doors, pool, props or new architecture. This is an environment asset with runtime sprites added later.
Style: keep the established bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy 2.5D quality, clean warm colored edge work, soft fresh sunlight, green/violet/amber perimeter accents. Do not change drawing style or the outside background.
Avoid: whole-scene zoom/crop, changed outer contour, shifted flowers, shifted tree roots, resized exits, huge paving rocks, 200–300 pixel stones, dark deep seams, repetitive giant honeycomb medallions, saturated yellow floor, straight tiled pattern, image blur, procedural texture noise, labels, watermark or pixel editing artifacts.
